description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

There’s something about you that makes others overlook you and forget about your presence. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.5KP9sOoLSGvj9EXp]{Beneath Notice} Talent, and if you make sure to not be in the centre of attention - like standing motionless and silent behind others - you can activate the benefits of that Talent as if your status is zero. You cannot gain this mutation if you already have @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.items.Item.UZQt9vDlxKlrIl9D]{Magnetic Presence} or @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.items.Item.kfRYjEQd9oAn8v2T]{Tantalising Aura}. You can only gain this mutation once.
